listings.remarks: This is a uniquely beautiful home with a multitude of windows surrounded by the natural beauty. Two decks for outside enjoyment along with a large lot. Enjoy the fall foliage from every window! Many updates and upgrades including newer Milgard windows, Presidential Roof, Exterior and Interior paint, carpet in lower level, and much more. Vaulted ceilings, European style cabinets, granite counters, and an under-cabinet window add a cool flair to this good-sized kitchen. Hardwood floors on the main level. 2nd auxiliary kitchenette on lower level. New Carpet in lower level. Two-car garage and separate laundry room. Must see this home! Lake Oswego Schools. New Seasons is just a short distance! Easy walk to Springbrook Park!

Sweet Lake Oswego Tri-Level on a private ¼ acre lot! New roof and new exterior and interior paint. Great layout with a living room and family room, both with stone fireplaces, a formal dining room, and an eating nook. Open kitchen that gets lots of light with an island and pull-outs. Living room has a vaulted ceiling and large windows. Family room has a wet bar, adjacent bathroom, and a slider to the backyard. Fourth downstairs bedroom offers privacy and possible multigenerational living. Milgard windows and sliders. Large laundry room and lots of storage. Huge deck and backyard with garden beds. Located on a quiet street with easy access to local shopping center, tennis center, and City parks. Top-rated Lake Oswego schools.

Exceptional value in upscale Bryant Woods—now offered at $725,000! Ready to close in time for the holidays! This beautifully maintained home delivers the feel of affordable luxury with an open, light-filled floor plan designed for both comfortable everyday living and entertaining.The inviting living room features a soaring vaulted ceiling and mantled gas fireplace, flowing seamlessly into the dining room and a cozy sitting area with a second gas fireplace and dramatic floor-to-ceiling stone-tile hearth. Hardwood flooring and stone tile accents continue into the well-appointed kitchen featuring stainless steel appliances, generous workspace and a cook’s island.The private primary suite offers a beautifully updated bath with sleek finishes, step-in shower and walk-in closet, plus a slider providing direct access to the backyard, patio and hot tub. Two additional spacious bedrooms and a stylish guest bath with tub and shower provide plenty of room for family, guests or a home office.Step outside to a beautifully landscaped yard filled with evergreen trees, perennial flowers, herbs and strawberries—your own private retreat just steps from the amenities that make Bryant Woods so desirable. Walk to the resort-style community pools and enjoy an oasis of relaxation complete with cabanas and lanai. Nearby walking trails and Bryant Woods Nature Park offer even more opportunities to enjoy the outdoors.Convenient access to I-5 and I-205 makes getting around the Portland metro area easy. Make it your own with this outstanding opportunity to enjoy the lifestyle, amenities and setting of Bryant Woods at a more affordable price. Be settled in your new home just in time to celebrate the holidays!

Tucked into a peaceful, park-like setting on a large lot, this private daylight ranch offers surprisingly spacious living in Lake Oswego’s popular Bryant neighborhood. Ideally located on the west end of the lake, the home combines thoughtful updates, flexible living spaces, and easy access to the best of Lake Oswego. The main level welcomes you with a bright great room featuring gleaming refinished hardwood floors and a wood-burning fireplace, flowing seamlessly into the updated open kitchen. Northwest-inspired butcher block counters, subway tile backsplash, and newer stainless steel appliances create a warm and inviting space, while the kitchen opens directly to a beautiful outdoor deck—perfect for morning coffee, summer dinners, and entertaining. The main level also includes two bedrooms and a refreshed full bathroom.Downstairs, a spacious family room with a second fireplace provides plenty of room to relax, gather, or create a flexible living space, with direct access to the patio and expansive yard. Two additional bedrooms, the laundry space, and another refreshed bathroom complete the lower level, which features newer LVP flooring and brand-new carpet. Numerous cosmetic and system upgrades make this home truly move-in ready, including remodeled kitchen and bathrooms, vinyl windows, interior and exterior paint, refinished hardwoods, new carpet and LVP flooring, newer roof and gutters, AC, upgraded 200-amp electrical panel, flat deck membrane, and an exterior drainage system. Enjoy an exceptional location near top-rated schools and within access to three Lake Oswego easement locations—Lake Grove Swim Park, Goodin, and Springbrook—offering opportunities to enjoy life on and around the lake. Shops, restaurants, and grocery stores are also conveniently located within a 1/2 mile. Offering a peaceful setting, versatile living spaces, thoughtful updates, and access to lake easements, this home is an exceptional opportunity to enjoy all that Lake Oswego has to offer.

Spacious 5-bedroom home located on a quiet cul-de-sac in a convenient SW Portland/Lake Oswego area neighborhood. The well-designed floor plan offers generous living spaces, including both formal and informal areas and a main-level den/bedroom that works well for an office space, guests or flexible living needs. The kitchen features gas appliances, pantry storage, and a large eating area that connects to the family room with fireplace. Upstairs you’ll find five bedrooms, including a large primary suite with soaking tub, double vanity, and walk-in closet. Additional features include hardwood flooring in the kitchen and dining areas, central air conditioning, and a dedicated laundry room. The backyard offers a patio and manageable yard space for outdoor enjoyment. Convenient location with easy access to shopping, parks, and major commuter routes.Under FinCEN's new RRE Rule, transfers will be subject to reporting when buyers use entities or trusts to take title to residential real estate, when the transaction is all cash, privately financed or HELOC.

Incredible Price Drop!!!!! Welcome to this exceptional 6-bedroom, 4.5-bath traditional home in Portland's desirable Mountain Park neighborhood. Rich oak hardwood floors, custom crown molding, and three fireplaces create warm, inviting living spaces throughout. The flexible floor plan features two primary suites, including one on the main level, ideal for multigenerational living or guests. Enjoy multiple living areas, a bright sunroom, and a finished basement with a wet bar, perfect for entertaining, a media room, home gym, or recreation space. Relax on the charming front porch or private back patio surrounded by mature landscaping. Rare RV and boat parking add exceptional convenience. Ideally located near parks, scenic trails, shopping, dining, and major commuter routes, this home offers timeless style, versatile living, and an unbeatable location.

This inviting main level living Midcentury is ideally positioned in the heart of Lake Oswego, offering sweeping sunset views and optional access to Mountain Park pool/fitness/tennis clubhouse amenities! Delight in two spacious levels that include two family rooms with fireplaces offering potential for multi-generational living, a statement vaulted great room with floor to ceiling windows gazing over the private and expansive backyard, and a sense of stylish period charm throughout. Main level primary suite with backyard access plus two additional main level bedrooms and a full bathroom nearby. Intimate gatherings spill out onto the elevated covered view deck for sunset hour and downstairs on the covered patio accessing the lawns. Enjoy abundant storage with plenty of space for a wine cellar and key updates including a new HVAC system. Customize this haven and create a world all your own very near top-ranked Lake Oswego schools, restaurants, destination shopping, and all in a connected community where quality of life is simply the way of life, every day.

Significant Price Reduction! Tucked at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac in Lake Oswego’s desirable Uplands neighborhood, this beautifully maintained home enjoys a private, pastoral setting surrounded by beautifully landscaped grounds. Freshly re-finished hardwood floors bring a warm glow to the main level. Vaulted ceilings, skylights, a fireplace for chilly evenings create a home that lives larger than its size. The kitchen with a generous amount of cupboards has an eating bar, granite counters, and a sunny breakfast nook. Quality appliances are stainless, including the gas stove. The spacious primary suite has a beautifully updated bathroom with natural stone. A second bathroom is also appointed with natural stone. An oversized two-car garage offers additional storage. Step outside, there are two private patios overlooking a professionally landscaped backyard that is elegant in its beauty. Just a short walk to Lake Oswego Middle and High Schools, the home pairs a private setting with exceptional convenience and access to the Lake Grove Swim Park.

Set on an oversized 0.34-acre lot in Lake Oswego's Forest Highlands neighborhood, this home offers a rare combination of space, privacy, and possibilities. Inside, a flexible floor plan includes formal living and dining rooms plus a family room with a fireplace, vaulted ceilings, and sliding doors opening to a wood deck and in-ground pool in the private backyard. The primary suite features an adjoining bonus space filled with natural light, ideal for an office, studio, or home gym, while three additional bedrooms upstairs provide separation and functionality. Mature landscaping and generous outdoor space complete a property that could be an exceptional remodel candidate or the perfect Forest Highlands lot to build a custom home from the ground up. Conceptual renderings at the end of the photos illustrate the potential for what could be created on the site.

Life in Lake Grove feels right at home in this thoughtfully reimagined single-level retreat. Set on a corner lot surrounded by mature greenery, this home welcomes you with light-filled spaces, a dedicated office and extensive updates that make everyday living effortless.Mornings begin in the open kitchen, where an extra-long island offers room for coffee, conversation and whatever the day brings. Custom cabinetry, a pantry and premium stainless steel appliances keep everything within reach, while skylights brighten the adjoining living spaces. From quiet afternoons to a house full of guests, the flowing layout keeps everyone connected—all on one level.Throughout the home, the remodel brings thoughtful details to daily routines. The primary suite offers a redesigned bathroom with a glass-enclosed shower and a newly created walk-in closet with custom organizers. Additional bedrooms feature custom closet organization, while the office’s built-in storage provides a practical place to work, create or focus. Even laundry has its own finished space, complete with cabinetry, a counter and a sink.The updates extend well beyond the finishes: all windows were replaced in 2024, complemented by updated flooring, new interior doors, trim and hardware, fresh paint inside and out, a new front door, heat pump and generator hookup.When the day winds down, the private backyard invites dinner outside or a quiet moment among the greenery. It’s a welcoming place to settle into Lake Grove, with the ease of single-level living and the comfort of a home already thoughtfully renewed.

HUGE investment opportunity! Welcome to one of Multnomah Village's most charming and versatile homes just steps from Art Center. Built in 1920 and full of timeless character, this beautiful bungalow blends original craftsmanship with thoughtful updates, offering a home that is as functional as it is inviting. Warm hardwood floors, classic built-ins, original woodwork, and abundant natural light create an atmosphere that's both welcoming and full of personality. The spacious floor plan features 3 oversized bedrooms, a dedicated office or creative studio, a walk-in closet in the primary suite, and a charming butler's pantry that adds both character and everyday convenience. Outside, enjoy a fully fenced private backyard with room to garden, entertain, relax, or simply enjoy Portland's beautiful seasons. The lower level features its own exterior entrance, creating exciting possibilities for future ADU potential, multigenerational living, guest quarters, workshop space, or additional flex space (buyer to verify).Major updates provide peace of mind, including new interior paint (2026), new chimney (2026), sewer line replacement (2025), updated kitchen appliances, newer furnace, ductless heating and cooling, EV charger, and a decommissioned oil tank. Adding even more value, the property is zoned RM2 and has a successful history as a professionally managed short-term rental, offering flexibility for homeowners and investors alike. The location is truly exceptional. Just moments from the heart of Multnomah Village, you'll love being able to walk to neighborhood restaurants, coffee shops, boutiques, the weekly farmers market, Gabriel Park, the Multnomah Arts Center, and community events that make this one of Portland's most beloved neighborhoods. Whether you're searching for your forever home, a smart investment, or a property with room to grow and adapt to your lifestyle, this one-of-a-kind bungalow offers character and location in one remarkable package.Seller says "SELL".

NEW PRICE! REMODELED SINGLE LEVEL IN GARDEN HOME! Discover this thoughtfully updated home offering spacious areas for both entertaining and comfortable day-to-day living! The bright, open-concept interior is filled with natural light from large windows and skylights and features a beautifully updated kitchen with refreshed cabinetry, quartz countertops, an oversized island with custom built-ins, and stainless-steel appliances. The open dining area can accommodate an extended table as needed and and the lightfilled nook off the kitchen is perfect for morning coffee. A shiplap fireplace wall and updated flooring add warmth and character to the main living space, while spacious bedrooms and a primary suite with a custom built-in closet offer comfort and functionality throughout. Recent improvements include a kitchen update in 2022, exterior paint in 2023, and a new water heater and air conditioner in 2025. Best of all, you’re just two blocks from some favaorite conveniences such as Trader Joe’s, Starbucks, Garden Home Recreation Center, Old Market Pub, and Fanno Creek Trail, offering nearly 20 miles of paved trails for walking and biking. This home is turn-key ready for the next new home owners! Located in Washington County. Third bedroom w/ no closet.

Welcome home to this beautifully remodeled 1949 classic on a corner lot in the sought after Huber neighborhood. With 5 bedrooms, 3 full bathrooms, and 2,300 square feet across three levels, this home blends timeless character with modern comfort. The main level offers a warm living and dining room combo centered around a wood burning fireplace, perfect for cool Portland evenings. New luxury vinyl flooring flows throughout, complemented by new light fixtures and fresh interior and exterior paint for a crisp, move in ready feel. The kitchen has been completely refreshed with new cabinets, quartz countertops, and stainless steel appliances including a built in microwave and dishwasher. A true standout is the fully finished basement with separate living quarters, its own entrance, and a second full kitchen, ideal for extended family, a private guest suite, or potential rental income. Forced air heating with central air conditioning, an attached 2 car garage, a composition shingle roof, and a low maintenance yard with a deck for relaxing or entertaining round out the features. This home is the first phase of The Capitol Commons, a new detached condominium development, with impressively low HOA dues of just $159 per month. Adding to the appeal is a unique setting next to the future Jackson Middle School Athletic Hub, currently being transformed with new synthetic turf fields, an upgraded 8-lane track, field lighting, and improved pathways and landscaping. This major investment in the neighborhood will create an impressive recreational setting just steps from your door, with schools, parks, and everyday conveniences close by. Classic 1949 charm, today's comforts, and an exciting new neighbor make this one you will not want to miss.

Set on .71 acres in Vista Hills, this singular home may have a history reaching well beyond its recorded build date. The site is thought to have housed the way station for overnight travelers between Portland and Hillsboro along the historic Canyon Road corridor, route of the Great Plank Road in the 1850s. Beginning in the 1970s, the owner, an architect, transformed the structure through a sequence of additions, creating a distinctly Pacific Northwest home of wood, glass and unexpected geometries. Skylights, floor-to-ceiling windows and multiple decks, including a rooftop terrace, open the house to the surrounding woods, while the dramatic original stone fireplace remains at its heart, connecting its earliest history to the home that has grown around it.

Known for its quiet, tree-lined streets, friendly neighbors, and inviting atmosphere, it's a neighborhood where people put down roots. Perfectly positioned just minutes from I-5, downtown Portland, downtown Lake Oswego, shopping, dining, and parks, it offers just the right balance of peaceful living and everyday convenience.Thoughtfully updated throughout, this 3 bedroom, 2.5 bath house with mountain views provides the comfort of knowing the major improvements have already been done! The kitchen was beautifully remodeled in 2025 with Cambria quartz countertops, a new stainless steel sink, matte black faucet, freshly painted cabinetry, and a new range, creating a bright, inviting space for gatherings. The primary bathroom remodel, done in 2023, provides a relaxing retreat, while a new high-efficiency HVAC system (2023) fresh exterior paint (2024), new insulated garage door (2024), and new fiberglass front door add both style and peace of mind.Step outside and enjoy maintenance-free living! The front yard features turf for year-round curb appeal, while the backyard has been enhanced (2025) with a new deck and custom pergola, creating the perfect setting for entertaining, summer barbecues, or simply unwinding at the end of the day.Woodlee Heights is more than just a neighborhood—it's a community. Residents enjoy the neighborhood path to Stephenson Elementary, the cherished Fourth of July festivities, and the welcoming atmosphere that truly makes it a special place to call home. This is the one you've been waiting for!

Seller is ready to make a deal! Take advantage of this opportunity and bring your offer. Welcome to this beautifully updated, move-in ready Garden Home retreat! Featuring brand-new luxury vinyl plank flooring installed in June 2026 throughout the entire home, this single-level residence offers 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, and 1,422 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space.The beautifully renovated kitchen is the heart of the home, designed for both everyday living and entertaining. Enjoy Cambria quartz countertops, Omega soft-close cabinetry, KitchenAid stainless steel appliances, a professional-grade gas range with pot filler, Blanco single-basin sink, under-cabinet outlets, and generous prep and storage space.Vaulted ceilings and expansive windows fill the living and dining areas with natural light while framing views of the private backyard. The updated fireplace creates a warm and inviting gathering space, while the spacious primary suite features a custom-built closet designed for exceptional organization. An oversized two-car garage with tall ceilings provides outstanding storage and workspace flexibility.Step outside to a beautifully landscaped, fully fenced backyard surrounded by mature landscaping that creates a peaceful, private retreat—perfect for morning coffee, summer barbecues, gardening, or simply unwinding at the end of the day. Underground sprinklers help keep the lawn and landscaping looking their best year-round.Ideally located just one block from Garden Home Park and minutes from Fanno Creek Trail, Garden Home Recreation Center, Trader Joe's, Starbucks, Ace Hardware, Washington Square, and the shops and restaurants of Multnomah Village. Commuting is a breeze with Nike approximately 14 minutes away, Intel about 20 minutes, and downtown Portland approximately 12 minutes from home.With quality updates, timeless finishes, exceptional pride of ownership, and **no HOA**!

OPEN Sat 10/4 1-3:00 New price!! One level living. This vibrant and popular community is a hidden gem, yet minutes to local amenities. A well-loved home with a new roof, fresh interior paint throughout, new carpet and plush pad, a new oven and microwave. Welcoming you around the gracious entrance is a living room with a gas fireplace, providing ambiance at a moment’s notice. The vaulted kitchen gets an abundance of light from a skylight and back windows/slider. There’s a large island, a built-in desk, glass front cabinets, and lots of storage. The sunny breakfast area views outdoor privacy and a raised garden planter-perfect for picking bouquet flowers, growing tomatoes or your favorite vegetables. There’s also room on the wrap around deck for a table and umbrella making entertaining so enjoyable. The property is easy care, and out of sight below is additional guest parking. Meet new friends at the pool or community room, adding a new dimension to this charming home. Minutes to Tryon Creek Park trails, outstanding grocery shopping and easy I-5 access. Convenient to Lake Oswego either direction, or OHSU also!

Tucked away on a private dead-end street, this extraordinary 1912 Craftsman sits on over 1/2 acre of curated gardens and feels more like a country retreat than a city home. A truly magical setting. Mature plantings surround the property on all sides, from an incredible Japanese maple to sky-high rhododendrons, creating a private world where deer and bunnies occasionally wander through. This is urban farming at its finest, with a pond, greenhouse, extensive irrigation, and a 10,000-gallon cistern that collects rainwater for use in the gardens. The quintessential Craftsman exterior features shingle siding, architectural detailing, and a welcoming front porch, while the matching carriage house provides parking for two cars and abundant storage in its basement. The rustic lower level, currently used for gardening and yard tools, offers wonderful potential as a potting area or garden workshop. Inside, the charm and character continue. The formal entry opens to a spacious living room with wood floors and an architect-designed wood stove nook that brings both warmth and efficiency. At the back of the home, the open kitchen and dining area are framed by large windows overlooking the gardens, with doors opening to a private deck that feels suspended among the trees, like a treehouse in the garden. The kitchen features tiles collected by the owners during their travels, adding to the home’s warm, personal character. An office and full bath complete the main level. Upstairs, three cozy bedrooms and a full bath offer treetop views from nearly every window, with the bathroom enjoying an expansive outlook over the gardens and mature trees. The spacious basement offers natural light and a walk-out door to the yard. Thoughtful updates include newer double-pane windows and a newer furnace. Lovingly cared for by the same owners for nearly 50 years, this is a home with a soul, artful, eclectic, and completely unlike anything ordinary.https://rpt.greenbuildingregistry.com/hes/OR1025053

Roger Tilbury Park just around the corner and a quick stroll to Cedar Mill Elementary School. Easy access to HWY 26/217, NIKE Campus, 13 min to PGE park & 15 min to Downtown.

The spacious kitchen features abundant wood cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, a farmhouse sink, and an oversized center island. Upstairs, a private balcony with stunning views of Mt. Hood creates the perfect spot for slow mornings or evening wine.Outside, this home really shines—a generous deck made for summer dinners and entertaining, plus a dedicated play structure and backyard space that makes the outdoors just as inviting as the inside.All of this is in the heart of John’s Landing, with neighborhood coffee, dining, parks and the Willamette waterfront close by. Classic Portland character, beautifully refreshed, with space to gather, play and live in comfort.

Tucked into a peaceful Raleigh Hills setting, this 2,524-square-foot home offers a rare combination of privacy, tranquility and everyday convenience. Set on a secluded .20-acre lot along a quiet street, the property feels like a private retreat, surrounded by mature greenery and a beautifully landscaped Japanese-style garden with winding stone paths overlooking serene green space. The inviting outdoor setting offers a wonderful escape from the bustle of everyday life, while a spacious deck provides the perfect place to relax, entertain or simply enjoy the peaceful surroundings. Inside, hardwood floors, detailed millwork and two fireplaces bring warmth and character, while formal and informal living spaces offer flexibility for everyday living and gatherings. The gourmet kitchen features granite counters, a Viking range and refrigerator, Sub-Zero wine cooler, island, pantry and double ovens, with French doors opening directly to the deck and gardens. Upstairs, the primary suite offers a private retreat with a fireplace, walk-in closet, soaking tub and double sinks. Three additional bedrooms include an oversized 19' x 16' fourth bedroom, ideal for a bonus room, media room, office, gym or guest space. Fresh interior paint and refreshed landscaping were completed in June 2026. An exceptional opportunity to enjoy peaceful, private living in one of Raleigh Hills' most desirable settings.

The main level features inviting gathering spaces, including a spacious living room centered around a wood-burning fireplace and a generous dining area ideal for both everyday living and entertaining.
